format: ModelOpt MIXED_PRECISION: MLP NVFP4 W4A16 (group 16), Gated DeltaNet and attention projections FP8 per-tensor, lm_head NVFP4
why: NVIDIA's own quantization is preferred, as for the pair's checkpoint. Apache-2.0 and ungated; context up to 262K tokens per its card.

draft.why: The published DFlash2 block drafter for Qwen3.8-27B. Atlas verifies its blocks exactly, so it changes speed, not text.

overlay.why: TandemLLM's NVFP4 Gated DeltaNet and attention projections, quantized once from Qwen's BF16 release with GPTQ on about 150K tokens. In place of the checkpoint's FP8 GDN and the engine's load-time NVFP4 attention they cut the bytes a decode step reads by 2.4 GB (serial step 78.9 -> 69.2 ms) at +0.004 nats/token held-out NLL (code, prose, long context), with GSM8K-200 and the quality probe level. Weights only; no TandemLLM code is used.
